initialization: Inherited center-cell initial mass; the observation is already completed at time zero. Impulse models apply one completion injection then neutral drift; sustained models retain the observed driver throughout each interval.
future_input: No additional READ or observation. Propagate the two observed-sign-conditioned laws separately; form class mixtures only afterwards.
process: The fitted main-study finite interval law, including its one-event-per-interval and end-of-interval recovery approximation. This is not the separate CTMC or exact continuous Brownian renewal.
fresh_event_population: For each nonzero interval, retain joint source-active-bin by newly emitted event-sign mass under each observed driver. Compare selected source alone, source plus remembered driver, joint source/event sign, event sign alone, signed forced reset and equal forced reset on exactly the same event-selected population.
invariants: Finite nonnegative mass; unit transition rows and observation masses; common selected-population masses; Bayes information cannot improve under deterministic coarsening or class-independent reset kernels. Source-alone to event-sign data processing is required only for impulse models, whose interval law is independent of remembered observation.
interpretation: Prospectively declared secondary fitted-dynamics probe. It diagnoses available class-belief information in a controlled one-observation experiment. It does not test whole-policy maximal information, trained arbitrary-history recovery, causal task utility, neural-head accuracy, independent task generalization or production adoption.
reporting: Retain all 16 fits and six candidates, all horizons and zero-event cases. Report per-fit values and paired descriptive differences; no selection, retuning, significance gate or new efficacy claim.
execution_gate: Publish and remotely verify probe.py, plan.json and README.md before execution. Require verified published all-model seal; verify every main source, every 24-by-16 model and every sealed TRAIN-data hash before and after execution. Never open confirmation files.
cost: A supervisor captures the complete worker user+system CPU, wall time, peak RSS and exit status including imports, hash verification, probing and serialization; supervisor CPU is reported separately. Failed attempts and partial per-fit outputs remain available.
